title: Magazine’s New Senior Creative Producer for Video
body_markdown:
Todd St. John, a generative collaborator, has a new role defining and executing the team’s video strategy. Read more in the below note from the Magazine’s editor Jake Silverstein.


I’m thrilled to share that Todd St. John is joining our team as the Magazine’s new senior creative producer for video. After an extensive search, we’ve found exactly the right person to help us define and execute our new video strategy, pioneering new formats but also capitalizing on the existing visual expertise of our art and photo departments.


Todd is a brilliant creative thinker who brings a wide-ranging set of skills and experience to the job. As a past collaborator with the Magazine, he also has a deep understanding of our editorial sensibility, visual style and journalistic rigor. And he possesses the vision to translate all of that into compelling original videos.


For the past nine months, Todd has been the creative director for video in the newsroom, working with design and video teams to strengthen the vision for news and shows videos produced by The Times. Before that he worked for decades as an independent multidisciplinary artist and designer, known for his work in illustration, animation, creative direction and video. He is the founder of the design consultancy HunterGatherer, and his portfolio includes collaborations with heavy hitters like Netflix, Google and The New Yorker.


From 2018 to 2020, Gail, creative director, and I worked closely with Todd and his team to create our weekly


[Behind the Cover](https://www.nytimes.com/series/behind-the-cover) video series. He was a thoughtful and generative collaborator, a constant source of creative ideas and a deft leader of his team. Todd’s work with us has shown his tremendous range. In addition to that long-running video project, he’s also created iconic visuals for numerous stories, including our


[cover story on cardboard](https://www.nytimes.com/2022/11/28/magazine/cardboard-international-paper.html) by Matt Shaer, and our


[cover story on A.D.H.D.](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/04/13/magazine/adhd-medication-treatment-research.html) by Paul Tough.


In his new role at the Magazine, Todd will lead our efforts to develop a video dimension to the Magazine’s editorial output. He’ll work closely with me, Gail, and Jessica, director of photography, as well as Solana Pyne, the newsroom’s video director. Todd will also be a part of hiring for two more dedicated video roles at the Magazine. Please join me in welcoming Todd to the team. His first day with us is Sept. 8.


— Jake
